lists.title.description: Heading and document title of the page of the user's lists, and its item in the main navigation.

lists.list.title.description: Heading of the region of the user's lists on the lists page.

lists.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {リスト # 件}}（上限 {max}）
lists.count.description: Read for the count beside the heading of the user's lists, drawn as '3 / 50'. {count} is the number of lists, {max} the most a user may have.

lists.empty.defaultMessage: まだリストはありません
lists.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of the user's lists.

lists.empty.description.defaultMessage: フォロー中の人をリストに入れると、その人たちの投稿をホームとは別に読めます。リストは自分にだけ見えます。
lists.empty.description.description: Text of the empty list of the user's lists, above the button that creates one.

lists.limit.defaultMessage: リストは {max} 個までです。使わないリストを削除すると作れます。
lists.limit.description: Shown in place of the button that creates a list, and in the add-to-list dialog, when the user has the most lists. {max} is that number.

lists.create.description: Button that opens the form that creates a list, and the title of that form.

lists.create.submit.description: Button that sends the form that creates a list.

lists.created.description: Shown above the user's lists after creating one. {name} is the new list's name.

lists.name.description: Label of the field with a list's name.

lists.name.description.defaultMessage: リストは自分にだけ見え、入れた人には知らされません。
lists.name.description.description: Description under the field with a list's name.

lists.name.required.defaultMessage: 名前を入力してください。
lists.name.required.description: Error of the empty name field of a list.

lists.name.too_long.defaultMessage: 名前は {max} 文字までです。
lists.name.too_long.description: Error of a list's name that is too long. {max} is the most characters.

lists.name.invalid.defaultMessage: 名前は 1 行で入力してください。
lists.name.invalid.description: Error of a list's name with line breaks or other control characters.

lists.save_failed.defaultMessage: リストを保存できませんでした。{reason}
lists.save_failed.description: Error in the form that creates or renames a list. {reason} says why.

lists.cancel.description: Button that closes the form that creates or renames a list without saving.

lists.member_count.description: The number of members of a list, in its row on the lists page and on the list's page.

lists.list_action.description: Accessible name of a button in a row of the user's lists. {action} is the button's visible text (for example 'Rename'), {name} the list's name.

lists.rename.description: Button in a row of the user's lists that opens the form that renames the list.

lists.rename.title.description: Title of the form that renames a list. {name} is the list's name.

lists.rename.submit.description: Button that saves a list's new name.

lists.renamed.defaultMessage: リストの名前を {name} に変えました。
lists.renamed.description: Read after a list is renamed. {name} is its new name.

lists.delete.description: Button in a row of the user's lists that deletes the list after asking, and the button of that dialog that does it.

lists.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before a list is deleted. {name} is the list's name.

lists.delete.description.defaultMessage: リストと、誰を入れたかが消えます。リストの中の人のフォローはそのままです。
lists.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that asks before a list is deleted.

lists.delete.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that asks before a list is deleted, keeping the list.

lists.deleted.description: Read after a list is deleted. {name} is the list's name.

lists.delete_failed.defaultMessage: {name} を削除できませんでした。{reason}
lists.delete_failed.description: Toast when a list could not be deleted. {name} is the list's name, {reason} says why.

lists.retry.description: Button that loads the members of a list, or the user's lists in the add-to-list dialog, again after they failed.

lists.manage.description: Link from a list's page to the page of the user's lists.

lists.members.manage.description: Button in a row of the user's lists that shows or hides the list's members, and the button of the empty state of a list's page without members.

lists.members.title.description: Heading of the region of a list's members. {name} is the list's name.

lists.members.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {メンバー # 人}}（上限 {max}）
lists.members.count.description: Read for the count beside the heading of a list's members, drawn as '12 / 1,000'. {count} is the number of members, {max} the most a list may have.

lists.members.search.defaultMessage: フォロー中の人を検索
lists.members.search.description: Label of the field that searches the accounts the user follows, to add one to a list.

lists.members.search.description.defaultMessage: 名前かハンドルで探します。リストに入れられるのは、フォローが承認された人だけです。
lists.members.search.description.description: Description under the field that searches the accounts the user follows.

lists.members.searching.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the accounts the user follows are searched.

lists.members.search_failed.defaultMessage: 検索できませんでした。{reason}
lists.members.search_failed.description: Shown when the search of the accounts the user follows failed. {reason} says why.

lists.members.no_match.defaultMessage: 一致するフォロー中の人はいません。ここで探せるのは、フォローしていて承認された人だけです。
lists.members.no_match.description: Shown when the search of the accounts the user follows found none.

lists.members.results.description: Accessible name of the results of the search of the accounts the user follows.

lists.members.add.description: Button of a search result that adds the account to the list.

lists.members.add_of.description: Accessible name of the button that adds an account to a list. {name} is the account's display name.

lists.members.added_mark.description: Mark of a search result that is already in the list, in place of the button that adds it.

lists.members.added.defaultMessage: {name} を {list} に追加しました。
lists.members.added.description: Read after an account is added to a list. {name} is the account's display name, {list} the list's name.

lists.members.add_failed.defaultMessage: 追加できませんでした。{reason}
lists.members.add_failed.description: Shown beside a search result that could not be added to the list. {reason} says why.

lists.members.not_followed.defaultMessage: リストに入れられるのは、フォローが承認された人だけです。
lists.members.not_followed.description: Shown when an account that the user does not follow could not be added to a list.

lists.members.limit.defaultMessage: 1 つのリストのメンバーは {max} 人までです。
lists.members.limit.description: Shown when a list has the most members, so that no one more can be added. {max} is that number.

lists.members.loading.defaultMessage: メンバーを読み込み中
lists.members.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while a list's members load.

lists.members.failed.defaultMessage: メンバーを読み込めませんでした
lists.members.failed.description: Heading of the error when a list's members could not load.

lists.members.empty.defaultMessage: このリストにはまだ誰もいません。上の欄でフォロー中の人を探してください。
lists.members.empty.description: Shown in place of the members of a list without members.

lists.members.list.description: Accessible name of the list of a list's members.

lists.members.remove.description: Button of a member that takes the account out of the list.

lists.members.remove_of.description: Accessible name of the button that takes an account out of a list. {name} is the account's display name.

lists.members.removed.defaultMessage: {name} を {list} から外しました。
lists.members.removed.description: Read after an account is taken out of a list. {name} is the account's display name, {list} the list's name.

lists.members.remove_failed.defaultMessage: メンバーを外せませんでした。{reason}
lists.members.remove_failed.description: Shown above a list's members when one could not be removed. {reason} says why.

lists.members.more.description: Button that loads more members of a list.

lists.members.more_failed.defaultMessage: 続きのメンバーを読み込めませんでした。{reason}
lists.members.more_failed.description: Shown under a list's members when the next ones could not load. {reason} says why.

lists.timeline.empty.heading.defaultMessage: このリストにはまだ誰もいません
lists.timeline.empty.heading.description: Heading shown on a list's page in place of the posts while the list has no members.

lists.timeline.empty.description.defaultMessage: フォロー中の人を足すと、その人の投稿がここに並びます。
lists.timeline.empty.description.description: Text under the heading shown on the page of a list without members.

lists.not_found.title.defaultMessage: リストが見つかりません
lists.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page of a list that does not exist or is not the user's.

lists.not_found.body.defaultMessage: このリストはないか、あなたのリストではありません。
lists.not_found.body.description: Text of the page of a list that does not exist or is not the user's.

lists.not_found.link.description: Link from the page of a list that was not found to the page of the user's lists.

lists.add_to_list.open.description: Item of the menu of a followed account's profile that opens the dialog that puts the account in the user's lists.

lists.add_to_list.title.description: Title of the dialog that puts an account in the user's lists. {name} is the account's display name.

lists.add_to_list.close.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the add-to-list dialog.

lists.add_to_list.lists.description: Accessible name of the checkboxes of the user's lists in the add-to-list dialog.

lists.add_to_list.manage.description: Link from the add-to-list dialog to the page of the user's lists.

lists.add_to_list.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the add-to-list dialog loads the user's lists.

lists.add_to_list.load_failed.defaultMessage: リストを読み込めませんでした
lists.add_to_list.load_failed.description: Heading of the error when the add-to-list dialog could not load the user's lists.

lists.add_to_list.none.defaultMessage: まだリストがありません。リストの画面で作ってから、ここで人を入れられます。
lists.add_to_list.none.description: Text of the add-to-list dialog while the user has no lists.

lists.add_to_list.saving.description: Shown under a list's checkbox in the add-to-list dialog while its change is saved.

lists.add_to_list.added.description: Read after the account of the add-to-list dialog is put in a list. {list} is the list's name.

lists.add_to_list.removed.description: Read after the account of the add-to-list dialog is taken out of a list. {list} is the list's name.

lists.add_to_list.failed.defaultMessage: リストを変えられませんでした。{reason}
lists.add_to_list.failed.description: Shown under a list's checkbox in the add-to-list dialog when the change failed. {reason} says why.
